STIG ID: RHEL-09-251015
STIG version: V2R9  benchmark date: 01 Jul 2026
Rule title: The firewalld service on RHEL 9 must be active.
CAT: II
CCI: CCI-000382, CCI-002314
NIST SP 800-53 controls: CM-7 b, AC-17 (1)

Check command / check text:
Verify that "firewalld" is active with the following command:

$ systemctl is-active firewalld 

active

If the firewalld service is not active, this is a finding.

Fix command / fix text:
To enable the firewalld service run the following command:

$ sudo systemctl enable --now firewalld

Expected output: not captured yet — no capture record exists for this STIG ID/RHEL version pair (content/expected_output.json).

Assembled command (RHEL 9, blast green):
systemctl is-active firewalld

Flags:
  status — unverified — see man page
  is-active — unverified — see man page
